propertySets.name: Pset_MobileTelecommunicationsApplianceTypeRemoteUnit
propertySets.definition: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of  IfcMobileTelecommunicationsAppliance and types of IfcMobileTelecommunicationsApplianceType with the predefined type set to REMOTEUNIT.

properties.name: NumberOfInterfaces
properties.definition: Indicates the types of interfaces and their number in the device.

properties.name: NumberOfAntennas
properties.definition: Indicates the number of antennas integrated in the device.

properties.name: RUConnectionType
properties.definition: Indicate the connection type between the remote unit and the master unit.
